title: Crash at startup with SIGILL
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.1, 4.5

### System information

Linux - Godot 4.5.1 Stable - Intel GM665

### Issue description

Hello, I've been trying to use godot on my machine and it crashes on startup with a `SIGILL` instruction. I used the version packaged for Arch Linux which is: `4.5.1-1`

The crash is systematic, and the package works on other machines with the same linux version. Maybe godot is compiled with some specific instruction set (my machine is kinda old) ? 

Here is as much info as I could gather:
```
uname -a
Linux sevastopol-station 6.18.5-arch1-1 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 11 Jan 2026 17:10:53 +0000 x86_64 GNU/Linux
```

```
           PID: 24454 (godot)
           UID: 1000 (ahub)
           GID: 1000 (ahub)
        Signal: 4 (ILL)
     Timestamp: Thu 2026-01-15 18:49:05 CET (5s ago)
  Command Line: godot
    Executable: /usr/bin/godot
 Control Group: /user.slice/user-1000.slice/session-1.scope
          Unit: session-1.scope
         Slice: user-1000.slice
       Session: 1
     Owner UID: 1000 (ahub)
       Boot ID: b93c20e1cde14c07a6080f7669bde0da

                #1  0x00007efffd227764 __libc_start_main (libc.so.6 + 0x27764)
                #2  0x000055fefa6f91a5 n/a (/usr/bin/godot + 0xda21a5)
                ELF object binary architecture: AMD x86-64
```

The full list of my hardware.
[hardware.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24649947/hardware.txt)

I can't attach the dump file so I uploaded it at the following address : https://0x0.st/P8yT.elf

### Steps to reproduce

Launch godot, even without a project.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

None.
